system.description: The town watch of @UUID[Compendium.stonetop.stonetop-journal.JournalEntry.uXlyry9CpXUz4ooR]{Marshedge}, dominated by @UUID[Compendium.stonetop.stonetop-journal.JournalEntry.rztqfU6X75vkMarl]{Brennan}'s old gang, the Claws. Whether a given guard protects the town or preys on it depends entirely on which sort you've crossed: an Ex-Claw out to lord over others, a Loyalist who'll protect the town no matter what, or a green New recruit just trying to avoid danger and punishment.
